note: fields by ROLE only; values are discovered from the data by queries.py discover (fixed rank/percentile rules). The mapping has geoip.country_name / geoip.city_name keywords, but no document of the OSB http_logs corpus fills them (cardinality 0 on all 247,249,096 docs), so they cannot drive term or aggregation ops. The keyword role is held by request.raw (keyword, about 60,600 values) and clientip (ip, about 1.15 million values): an ip field keeps sorted-set doc values like a keyword (terms, cardinality, composite, sort), while its term query runs on points.
corpus_base_urls_note: the pinned workload (29dd7e1f) removed base-url in faf49bbd; the old CloudFront URL still serves the same files (sizes and line counts equal workload.json; sha256 in br-httplogs/ingest.json)
ingest_bulk_ops_note: the workload's append-no-conflicts-index-only procedure (used for the stock ingest) bulk-loads with index-append only; the other bulk ops add ingest pipelines, the unparsed corpus or updates
multi_match_fields_note: http_logs has one text field; the default (text fields + the highest-cardinality keyword field) picks clientip, an ip field, and multi_match of a text query on it fails with HTTP 400
